# System Architecture Overview

The system architecture consists of several decoupled services communicating over HTTP and message queues.

## Authentication Service

Authentication is handled via JSON Web Tokens signed with HMAC-SHA256. Tokens expire after thirty minutes of inactivity.

### Refresh Tokens

Refresh tokens are stored in Redis with an absolute expiration time of seven days. Replay attacks are mitigated by token rotation.

## Storage Layer

PostgreSQL provides relational persistence while the pgvector extension stores chunk embeddings for similarity search.
